sentences.en: The website suffered a denial of service attack from 4chan.
sentences.zh: 该网站遭受了来自4chan的拒绝服务攻击。

sentences.en: Denial can be a comfort but it can't change reality.
sentences.zh: 否认可能是一种慰藉，但它不能改变现实。

sentences.en: Denial of self is not the same as self-denial.
sentences.zh: 自我否定与克制是不同的。

senses.zh: 否认，否定；拒绝，拒绝承认；克制，自制
